senses.gloss:
† तीव् तीव्, i. 1, Par. To become fat.
 --Cf. तु.

तीव्र तीव्र, probably तिज् + वन् + अ, (with र् for न्, cf. तिग्म and तीक्ष्ण), adj., f. रा.
 1. Sharp, Bhartṛ. 2, 77.
 2. Hot, Bhartṛ. 3, 19; flashing, Rām. 3, 62, 11.
 3. Violent, MBh. 7, 6893; deep (of darkness), Arj. 8, 13.
 4. Bad, MBh. 1, 3097.
तीव्रता तीव्र + ता, f. Heat; in अ-, moderate temperature, Rājat. 1, 41.
